Framework-owned components with typed slots

Your code lives in the slots; the compiler owns everything around them, so each screen ships exactly the HTML, CSS and JS it needs.

Get started GitHub

Slots

A slot is data plus an optional render function. Never a component.

Compiled shell

Layout components run in the compiler and leave no React behind.

Typed end to end

TypeScript 7 checks the emitted TSX; errors land on your source.
